item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Separate naming directions from wording variants","mechanism":"Group suggestions by their stated rationale and constraints addressed, not merely by similar spelling or sound.","implementation":"Add rationale and constraint fields. Allow multiple direction memberships; preserve immutable originals and privately recorded authorship through grouping and ungrouping.","check":"Submit two similar names with different rationales; verify both directions remain visible and each original remains recoverable.","risk":"Manual grouping can impose one person's interpretation; allow disputed memberships."},{"action":"Make rejections depend on versioned constraints","mechanism":"Attach each rejection to an explicit reason and constraint version so changed assumptions expose decisions needing reconsideration.","implementation":"Store rejection explanations and linked constraint versions. On constraint edits, mark affected rejections 'review needed' without automatically restoring or accepting names.","check":"Reject a name against a constraint, then revise that constraint; verify the rejection is flagged and its original explanation retained.","risk":"Frequent constraint edits may create excessive review notifications."},{"action":"Give late suggestions an anonymous first-review queue","mechanism":"Separate initial evaluation from social signals and previous discussion, giving every submission a review opportunity.","implementation":"Hide authors, reactions, and prior verdicts during first review. Allocate unseen suggestions by fewest completed reviews, breaking ties randomly; retain access-controlled private authorship.","check":"Add a late alternative; verify assignment, author masking, and rationale capture before existing discussion appears. Inspect ordering for popularity inputs.","risk":"Distinctive wording can still reveal authors; anonymity cannot be guaranteed."},{"action":"Show hard-constraint conflicts beside every name","mechanism":"Keep support and eligibility separate: popularity cannot erase an unresolved conflict with a declared hard constraint.","implementation":"Add a visible constraint matrix with meets, conflicts, and unknown states, each backed by a user explanation. Keep conflicting names visible; calculate no winner.","check":"Give a popular name a documented hard-constraint conflict; verify its warning persists despite support, with no automatic removal or selection.","risk":"Disputed interpretations require visible counterarguments rather than authoritative-looking status labels."}],"abstention_reason":""}
